No,
Fastenal
does not sell or distribute wearable medical devices.
Core Focus of Fastenal
Industrial & Construction Supplies:
Primarily distributes fasteners, tools, metal-working items, and hardware.
MRO and Safety Products:
Supplies general industrial safety gear (such as PPE, harnesses, and gloves) and MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) inventory solutions.
Healthcare Support:
While they supply basic facility, safety, and infrastructure components (like medical-grade isolation transformers) to healthcare providers, they do not stock patient-facing or diagnostic wearable medical technology.

Fastenal is an industrial supply distributor and
does not manufacture or specialize in medical devices like continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, or remote patient monitoring systems
. You are likely looking for consumer and medical health tech devices used in telehealth and personal wellness.
